state_writes: graveyard move when no defeating trigger is pending
timing: protector is chosen after priority passes as the Battle enters, not when it is cast
protector repair occurs as a state-based action except while the Battle is being attacked
the intrinsic Siege trigger is queued when the last defense counter is removed
targets: a Battle may be selected as a combat defender by any attacking player other than its protector
Battle damage and any-target support use derived Battle type
choices: the controller chooses a legal protector as the Battle enters
the controller chooses a replacement legal protector when required
hidden_information: Battle, protector, defense, attack, and trigger state are public
the transformed face remains card-definition information rather than hidden game state
apnap: each Battle's controller makes its own protector choice
complete simultaneous protector-choice ordering remains blocked
layers: derived card types, subtypes, and copied defense are consulted at every relevant event
replacement_effects: intrinsic defense counters are initialized on battlefield entry
complete replacement ordering for the Siege exile and transformed cast remains blocked
copy: copies entering as Battles initialize copied printed defense
a copied Siege with no final defense-counter removal does not receive the defeated trigger
control_change: a Siege controller who is also its protector must choose an opponent as the new protector
zone_change: protector is cleared on ordinary zone changes and preserved from the stack through Battle entry
Siege defeated resolution must use the exact source incarnation
source_leaves: an exact-incarnation pending trigger defers the zero-defense state action
a trigger from an old object incarnation does not protect the current Battle

variants: zero-defense Battle with and without a pending source trigger
rulings: Invasion of Gobakhan 2023-04-14: a Siege controller chooses an opponent as protector while it enters
Invasion of Gobakhan 2023-04-14: players other than the protector may attack the Battle and only the protector's creatures may block for it
Invasion of Gobakhan 2023-04-14: a zero-defense Battle remains only while its own triggered ability is pending
Invasion of Gobakhan 2023-04-14: a Siege whose last defense counter is removed exiles and may be cast transformed

implementation.component: CommanderEngine Battle entry, combat, trigger, damage, and protector state paths

known_blockers: native Siege defeated-trigger resolution does not yet exile and offer the exact transformed free cast; it fails closed to arbiter resolution
nonspell and token Battle entry paths do not yet suspend for an as-enters protector choice unless a trusted caller supplies the selected protector
attacking or blocking creatures becoming Battles and Battles changing controller during combat are not yet removed from combat by every continuous-effect path
future Battle subtypes are rejected until their protector predicates are present in a pinned Comprehensive Rules snapshot
complete simultaneous/APNAP protector choices and all Battle-targeting interactions are not implemented
the current Oracle snapshot contains two not-yet-Commander-legal Control Point previews that postdate the pinned rules snapshot and remain unsupported
